tasks.title: Implement private identity, guardian-consent and music workflows
tasks.acceptance: Private identity/residency evidence uploads and chapter-authorized review are durable and isolated; local guardian requests use bounded account-scoped pagination, reject duplicate/out-of-order rows and malformed or non-advancing cursors in the browser, and use owner-scoped notice links; pending requests remain withdrawable with unavailable counterpart identifiers redacted. Guardian relationship and event consent use verified authority, music files are inspected, and retention/readiness policy is approved and enforced before this task is done. Pagination, notice links, indexes and role workflows remain to be verified. JPEG/PNG uploads are decoded with strict dimension and pixel bounds before scanning; PDFs receive strict structural parsing with an 8 MiB per-stream cap, a 24 MiB estimated retained-object budget and a 100,000-object ceiling. One per-process slot serializes private object download, validation and scanning; an exact aggregate heap/decompression bound, parser OS isolation, complete embedded-resource inspection and role workflows remain open.

tasks.title: Deliver durable chapter-scoped in-app notifications
tasks.acceptance: Chapter members can read only their own bounded notification inbox, receive an atomic unread count, and idempotently acknowledge a notification; the web inbox keys displayed state to the current account and chapter and checks response scope; crew-invitation acceptance, entry review decisions, verification review decisions, local guardian request updates, judge-panel assignment changes, manual music review outcomes, battle ballot closure for the recorded draft creator, finance and local PayMongo payment transitions to the payer and distinct crew manager, account support updates, event staff assignment changes, eligible online check-in, revisioned stage-position transitions and published results produce notices. Registration approvals and stage-position transitions atomically queue roster delivery; publication queues bounded per-entry expansion followed by roster delivery. Delivery rechecks current roster and membership. Global HQ can inspect bounded pending-job, recorded-failure and unreadable-metadata samples; workers isolate malformed jobs and apply a retry cooldown. Durable recovery, multi-instance behavior, access controls and role rehearsal remain to be verified; followers, corrections, other event triggers, delivery preferences, and external delivery stay unfinished. The browser validates bounded record shapes and accepts only same-origin relative notification destinations. The API bounds notification text and enforces same-origin relative destinations on write and read. Stage hold changes deliver one generic notice to other assigned active marshals, using the hold revision for deduplication. Director stage-access changes notify only added/removed marshals with revision-keyed replay deduplication and current-membership checks.
